title: WaterSound Crossings C-112 - 100 S Bridge Lane
h1: WaterSound Crossings C-112 - 100 S Bridge Lane
description_expanded: HOME HIGHLIGHTS:- Gated Community with on-site Security- Great views of the Gulf and natural sand dunes- Fantastic porch spaces- Pool and beach are just yards away- From March 1st to October 31st, 2024, the rental of this property includes one beach -service set (2 beach chairs and 1umbrella)- Private deeded beach access- Free WiFi- Complete Clean Linen Participant - All linens, including comforters, laundered upon every checkout*This property comes with 1 designated parking space, and 1 first-come first-serve parking space. Please note first come first serve parking is limited and not guaranteed. This condo permits a maximum of 2 vehicles through the community security gate.*Beginning in March 2025 and continuing through 2026, the WaterSound Crossings condominiums will undergo an extensive exterior refurbishment project. During this period, residents and guests should expect significant construction activity, including the boarding of windows and restricted access to balconies in affected buildings. These measures are necessary to ensure safety and facilitate the successful completion of the work.DETAILS: Sit back and unwind at WaterSound Crossing C-112. Nestled a short stroll from the pristine beach, this 3-bedroom, 3-bathroom condo sleeps 8 and is the perfect escape for families or groups seeking 30A fun and relaxation. Guests will love taking in the Gulf views, unwinding on the peaceful porches, and cooling off in the community pool. With The Big Chill’s family-friendly fun, entertainment, and dining within walking distance, guests have everything they need for a delightful beach vacation!Classic and coastal styles mix throughout this beautiful 2-story property. Step inside to discover tile floors perfect for post-beach cleanup and crisp white wainscoting, adding an elegant touch. The first floor features a laundry room and a dedicated office space, great for remote workers. Off the hall, a cozy sleeping nook with curtains for privacy and a twin-over-twin bunk bed offers kids their own nautical hideaway. The spacious primary bedroom has an inviting king bed, a private bathroom, and an expansive porch with cushioned wicker seating, overlooking the rolling dunes.The refined living, dining, and kitchen spaces await upstairs—conveniently connected so guests can easily converse. Along the back wall, oversized windows let in natural light and showcase glimpses of the Gulf’s turquoise waters. In the living space, soft textures, soothing grays, and sea-inspired imagery reflect the relaxation to come. Unwind with a book on the plush couch or enjoy a night of movies and laughter around the TV. The well-designed kitchen provides a picturesque setting for cooking with granite countertops and high-end appliances, including a Viking oven. Enjoy meals together at the large, stylish dining set seating 6, with 3 additional seats at the breakfast bar. Through the adjoining doors, a sprawling balcony offers shade and a table for sipping drinks while appreciating the Gulf view and tranquil breeze. When it’s time to retire, guests can rest comfortably in the 2 guest bedrooms with 1 queen bed and 2 twin beds, respectively.Enjoy convenient entertainment, quick beach access, and wonderful community amenities at WaterSound Crossing C-112. Parking is available for up to 2 vehicles, with 1 dedicated parking spot, making it easy to explore. For beach access, simply follow the boardwalk at the back of the building. Book today for a vacation to remember!SLEEPING ARRANGEMENTS: (Sleeps 8) FIRST FLOOR:- Primary Bedroom: King Bed, Private Bathroom With Shower/Tub- Hallway Bunks: Twin over Twin Bunk bedSECOND FLOOR:- Guest Bedroom: Queen Bed, Private Bathroom With Shower/Tub- Guest Bedroom: Two Twin Beds, Private Bathroom With Shower/TubAMENITIES INCLUDE: Community Pool, Gulf Views, and 2 first-come, first-served parking spaces. Complete Clean Linen Participant - ALL linens, including comforter comforters, are laundered upon every checkout. 360 BLUE STAFF & SERVICES: Exclusive Guest Experiences, Concierge Services, Grocery Delivery, Private Chef & More (Extra costs & advanced notice may be required)*Weddings or parties/groups of people or guest of guest are not allowed at this home. If this policy is violated, you may be asked to vacate the property and forfeit any rental payments and be subject to HOA, community, and 360 Blue fines.
